_evidence: The car-order list at 0x0066fe3c (zero in the image) is built by 0x004091b5: 22 words k*0x41c (byte offsets of the 22 car records at 0x0066fef0), a 0xffff word before it (0x0066fe3a) and one after it (0x0066fe68, [0x00679b00]=0x2c). Entries vary as any record offset or a 0xffff terminator (shorter lists); the two guard words stay 0xffff as 0x004091b5 leaves them. 0x00408f42 searches it forward for esi-0x0066fef0 (stops at a negative word) and stores 2*i (or 0) in record bytes +0x7d/+0x415, so every record's +0x7d is even 0..42. 0x004083ac walks backwards from list+[+0x7d]-2 to the 0x0066fe3a guard, skipping records with +0x7a bit 7, else returns the +0x68 difference. 0x00413ea0 walks forward from list+[+0x7d]+2 to the 0x0066fe68 guard, testing record +0x7a (0x80, 0x40), +0x231 (0x40), +0x203 (2), comparing word +0x68 differences with the constant [0x00603b0c] and scaling words +0x9a/+0xd8; its callee 0x00414548 tests byte +0x235 < 2 (values 0..3, 0xff give both sides). Every walk stays between the guards and every list word is a record offset, so all reads stay inside the 22 records.
